input.quote: Risk of loss for all Base Components shall at all times remain with IBM. Risk of loss for all Customer Components shall at all times remain with Customer.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no insurance provision (a document-wide search for "insurance" returns nothing, and the outline has no insurance heading). IBM is a hosting/services provider that stores Customer Components and processes personal information on Customer's behalf (§ 5.3 Security; § 14.18 Data Protection), so the playbook requires standard coverages. Risk of Loss (§ 14.12) is the nearest related clause, so a new § 14.12A Insurance is inserted immediately after it, requiring CGL of USD 1M/2M, E&O of USD 2M, cyber liability of USD 5M and statutory workers' compensation, with certificates on request. Fallback of E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M is offered in the comment.

ops.text: IBM shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term of this Agreement and for one (1) year thereafter: commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; cyber liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000 covering IBM's processing of Customer data; and workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable law. IBM shall provide Customer with certificates of insurance evidencing such coverage upon request.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added a standard insurance provision because IBM hosts and processes our data but the Agreement is silent on coverage. Our position is commercial general liability of USD 1M/2M, E&O of USD 2M and cyber liability of USD 5M with certificates on request; we can accept E&O of USD 1M and cyber of USD 2M if needed.
proposal.summary: Insert new Section 14.12A requiring IBM to carry commercial general liability, professional (E&O), cyber and workers' compensation insurance, with certificates on request.
